title: Effects of small incision lenticule extraction and femtosecond laser-assisted in situ keratomileusis on choroidal thickness and blood flow density in patients with myopia

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs License)

indication: myopia (inclusion: SE -3.00 to -10.00 D, age 18-30 years, normal fundus); single-centre comparison of SMILE and FS-LASIK, choroidal outcomes

groups.description: FS-LASIK (VisuMax flap, AMARIS-500E excimer); 21 patients, 42 eyes (both eyes operated)

series.baseline_label: Pre-operation SE (Table II A, SMILE row)
series.notes: mean ± SD (footnote: mean ± SD or median; these cells are mean ± SD); both eyes of each patient counted, as in the article; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Pre-operation SE (Table II A, FS-LASIK row)
series.notes: mean ± SD; both eyes of each patient counted, as in the article; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: tII-ETM-31-2-13032 row P-value and columns F/chi2-value, P-value

exclusions.reason: same preoperative reference as the Table II pre-operation column; not duplicated (see notes on the assignment conflict)

notes: Table I and the Results text give the two groups' preoperative SE (mean ± SD) in the opposite assignment to the pre-operation column of Table II; Table II (the table holding the follow-ups) is cited for both series, cell text not edited.
Refraction method not stated (Methods: SE measured before surgery and at 1 week, 1 month and 3 months); recorded as unstated.
Target refraction not stated (surgical plan based on the preoperative refraction); recorded as unstated.
All surgeries were bilateral; the article analyses eyes (SMILE 70, FS-LASIK 42), so two eyes per patient are included in each mean.
Axial length, ablation depth, choroidal thickness (Table III) and choriocapillaris blood flow density (Table IV) are tabulated; not extracted.
